description: This file defines a React functional component 'ViewDetailsModal' which renders a modal dialog displaying detailed information of an arbitrary JSON object. It includes utility functions for formatting labels, currency values, and rendering values based on their type, with special handling for user cost keys. The component is designed to be reusable across the application for viewing details in a consistent, formatted manner.

methods.name: ViewDetailsModal
methods.description: React functional component that renders a modal window displaying formatted JSON details with special handling for user cost keys.

methods.name: isUserCostKeyLoose
methods.description: Determines whether a key matches patterns indicating it represents a user cost, using regex matching.

methods.name: toNumberLike
methods.description: Converts a value to a number using 'parseUsdToNumber' utility, returning null if conversion fails.

methods.name: renderValue
methods.description: Converts a value to a displayable string or JSX element, with special formatting for user cost keys and objects/arrays.
